description: A maintenance manager must book an overhaul of the shared C-7 compressed-air compressor and finalize the outage, production protection, repair, and statutory inspection controls before the work is released.

shared_context.S1: Compressor C-7 supplies compressed air to both Line 2 and Line 4, and its overhaul is due before the next campaign.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the binding decision on the maintenance window and return-to-service plan.
shared_context.S3: The plant normally records a maintenance work order, protects affected production commitments, and completes required safety checks before releasing shared utility equipment.
shared_context.S4: The plant's maintenance-booking checklist requires confirmation of production impact, EHS release requirements, and the technical work scope before a shared utility overhaul is booked.

PF1.text: Jon checked the customer order system this morning and confirmed that Line 4 must run at full rate starting Saturday at 06:00; Line 2 can be stopped from Friday at 22:00 through Saturday at 06:00. He has not transferred this window into the maintenance calendar yet.

PF2.text: Priya's EHS review found that C-7's pressure-vessel relief-valve certification expired, and the vessel may not return to service until a licensed inspector witnesses a relief-valve test and signs the inspection record. She completed the review yesterday, but the signed finding is still awaiting entry in the plant compliance register.

PF3.text: Cal's teardown assessment identified the compatible SK-B seal kit in stores and established that replacing the seal takes exactly 5 hours, followed by a mandatory 30-minute pressure test; including isolation and controlled restart, the C-7 outage must be scheduled for exactly 6 hours. He has not updated the draft work order with these details.

acceptance_conditions: The overhaul must start Friday at 22:00.
The C-7 outage must be scheduled for exactly 6 hours.
Line 4 must be protected until Saturday at 06:00.
The SK-B seal kit must be used.
Seal replacement must be planned for exactly 5 hours.
A pressure test must occur before restart.
A licensed inspector must witness the return-to-service inspection.
A relief-valve test must be required.
A maintenance work order, production-protection record, and statutory inspection record must be committed.
The expired certification finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C9: any(c.get('type') in ['work_order', 'record_work_order'] or ('work order' in c.get('detail', '') and '6-hour' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c.get('type') == 'production_protection' or ('Line 4' in c.get('detail', '') and 'Saturday 06:00' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any(c.get('type') in ['ehs_release', 'ehs_inspection', 'compliance_register'] or 'inspection record' in c.get('detail', '') or 'compliance register' in c.get('detail', '') or 'signed relief-valve' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed order changes the maintenance start to exactly Friday 22:00, requires Line 4 protection until Saturday 06:00, and adds the production-protection record.
The expired certification changes the return-to-service plan by requiring a licensed inspector, a witnessed relief-valve test, a statutory inspection record, and citation of PF2.

The teardown assessment changes the work package to the SK-B kit, exactly 5 hours of seal replacement, a pre-restart pressure test, and an exactly 6-hour outage recorded in the maintenance work order.
